decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting has long certification and sales cycles, so uncertainty remains high and the option is worth keeping open until orders are confirmed.
This general interior luminaire has had enough market exposure to show it is undifferentiated among many interior options, making its value unlikely to justify further commitment.
As the flagship pendant aligned with the firm's strategic focus on LED and human-centric lighting, its option value remains high and it is still actively promoted.
The marine searchlight still has unresolved niche uncertainty, and keeping costs appear modest, so the firm retains the option.
